AGGRESSIVE_SAFE_MODE.desc: Forces a aggressive safe mode where issues like unsafe thread access will resort in fatal exceptions

BINDINGS_GLOBAL_INSTALL.desc: Install bindings to global Python directory? (might need root)

ENABLE_LOCAL_BUILD_SHORTCUTS.desc: Disables some build steps which are only relevant for releases to speed up compilation time for development

ENABLE_UNITY_BUILDS.desc: Enable Unity builds, that is compiling several .cpp files in the same compilation unit (EXPERIMENTAL. Not recommended for production builds)

HAS_KDE_QT5_FONT_STRETCH_FIX.desc: Using KDE's Qt 5.15 fork with the QFont stretch fix

HAS_KDE_QT5_PDF_TRANSFORM_FIX.desc: Using KDE's Qt 5.15 fork with the PDF brush transform fix

HAS_KDE_QT5_SMALL_CAPS_FIX.desc: Using KDE's Qt 5.15 fork with the QFont::SmallCaps fix

PEDANTIC.desc: Determines if we should compile in pedantic mode.

PUSH_TO_CDASH.desc: Determines whether test results should be pushed to CDASH site

QGIS_INSTALL_SYS_LIBS.desc: If set to TRUE install all required system libs in the output package

SIP_GLOBAL_INSTALL.desc: Install sip source files to system sip directory? (might need root)

WITH_3D.desc: Determines whether QGIS 3D library should be built

WITH_ANALYSIS.desc: Determines whether QGIS analysis library should be built

WITH_APIDOC.desc: Determines whether the QGIS API doxygen documentation should be built

WITH_ASTYLE.desc: Deprecated. Should be OFF. If you plan to contribute you should reindent with scripts/prepare_commit.sh (using 'our' astyle)

WITH_AUTH.desc: Determines whether QGIS authentication methods should be built

WITH_BINDINGS.desc: Determines whether Python bindings should be built

WITH_COPC.desc: Determines whether Cloud Optimized Point Cloud (COPC) support should be built

WITH_CRASH_HANDLER.desc: Determines whether the QGIS crash handler application should be built

WITH_CUSTOM_WIDGETS.desc: Determines whether QGIS custom widgets for Qt Designer should be built

WITH_DESKTOP.desc: Determines whether QGIS desktop should be built

WITH_DRACO.desc: Determines whether Draco support should be built

WITH_EPT.desc: Determines whether Entwine Point Cloud (EPT) support should be built

WITH_GRASS7.desc: Determines whether GRASS 7 plugin should be built

WITH_GRASS8.desc: Determines whether GRASS 8 plugin should be built

WITH_GRASS_PLUGIN.desc: Determines whether the GRASS c++ plugin should be built

WITH_GSL.desc: Determines whether GSL library should be used

WITH_GUI.desc: Determines whether QGIS GUI library should be built

WITH_HANA.desc: Determines whether SAP HANA Spatial support should be built

WITH_INTERNAL_LAZPERF.desc: Determines whether LazPerf should be built from internal copy (recommended)

WITH_INTERNAL_MDAL.desc: Determines whether MDAL should be built from internal copy (recommended)

WITH_INTERNAL_MESHOPTIMIZER.desc: Determines whether MESHOPTIMIZER should be built from internal copy

WITH_INTERNAL_NLOHMANN_JSON.desc: Determines whether the vendored copy of nlohmann-json should be used

WITH_INTERNAL_O2.desc: Download and locally include source of o2 library

WITH_INTERNAL_POLY2TRI.desc: Determines whether POLY2TRI should be built from internal copy

WITH_INTERNAL_SPATIALINDEX.desc: Determines whether spatialindex should be built from internal copy

WITH_OAUTH2_PLUGIN.desc: Determines whether OAuth2 authentication method plugin should be built

WITH_ORACLE.desc: Determines whether Oracle support should be built

WITH_PDAL.desc: Determines whether PDAL support should be built

WITH_PDF4QT.desc: Determines whether the embedded PDF4Qt library should be build for PDF and HTML to QPainter conversion

WITH_POSTGRESQL.desc: Determines whether POSTGRESQL support should be built

WITH_PYTHON.desc: Determines whether Python support should be built (disabling it will in particular disable processing)

WITH_PY_COMPILE.desc: Determines whether Python modules in staged or installed locations should be byte-compiled

WITH_QGIS_PROCESS.desc: Determines whether the standalone "qgis_process" tool should be built

WITH_QSPATIALITE.desc: Determines whether QSPATIALITE sql driver should be built

WITH_QTGAMEPAD.desc: Determines whether QtGamepad should be tried for GPS positioning

WITH_QTSERIALPORT.desc: Determines whether QtSerialPort should be tried for GPS positioning

WITH_QUICK.desc: Determines whether QGIS Quick library should be built

WITH_QWTPOLAR.desc: Determines whether QwtPolar is available or whether functionality requiring QwtPolar should be disabled.

WITH_SERVER.desc: Determines whether QGIS server should be built

WITH_SERVER_LANDINGPAGE_WEBAPP.desc: Determines whether QGIS server landingpage webapp should be built (requires nodejs and yarn)

WITH_SERVER_PLUGINS.desc: Determines whether QGIS server support for Python plugins should be built

WITH_SPATIALITE.desc: Determines whether Spatialite support should be built (required for spatialite, virtual, wfs providers)

WITH_STAGED_PLUGINS.desc: Stage-install core Python plugins to run from build directory? (utilities and console are always staged)

WITH_VCPKG.desc: Use the vcpkg submodule for dependency management.
